predicates.title: Management port (RDP/SSH) open to the internet
predicates.description: An NSG inbound Allow rule exposes RDP (3389) or SSH (22) from the internet (source *, Internet, 0.0.0.0/0, or a wildcard port range).
predicates.attack_vector: Internet brute force / exploit -> host compromise
predicates.recommendation: Restrict management access to Azure Bastion or specific admin IPs; remove broad inbound rules.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' | mv-expand rule = properties.securityRules | extend p = rule.properties | where p.access == 'Allow' and p.direction == 'Inbound' | where p.sourceAddressPrefix in ('*','Internet','0.0.0.0/0','Any') | where p.destinationPortRange in ('22','3389','*') or set_has_element(p.destinationPortRanges,'22') or set_has_element(p.destinationPortRanges,'3389') | project id, name = rule.name, nsgName = name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, direction = p.direction, access = p.access, sourceAddressPrefix = p.sourceAddressPrefix, destinationPortRange = p.destinationPortRange, destinationPortRanges = p.destinationPortRanges

predicates.title: Database port open to the internet
predicates.description: An NSG inbound Allow rule exposes a database port (1433/3306/5432) from the internet (source *, Internet, 0.0.0.0/0, or a wildcard port range).
predicates.attack_vector: Direct internet database access -> data breach
predicates.recommendation: Place databases behind private endpoints; remove internet-facing DB port rules.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' | mv-expand rule = properties.securityRules | extend p = rule.properties | where p.access == 'Allow' and p.direction == 'Inbound' | where p.sourceAddressPrefix in ('*','Internet','0.0.0.0/0','Any') | where p.destinationPortRange in ('1433','3306','5432','*') or set_has_element(p.destinationPortRanges,'1433') or set_has_element(p.destinationPortRanges,'3306') or set_has_element(p.destinationPortRanges,'5432') | project id, name = rule.name, nsgName = name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, direction = p.direction, access = p.access, sourceAddressPrefix = p.sourceAddressPrefix, destinationPortRange = p.destinationPortRange, destinationPortRanges = p.destinationPortRanges

predicates.title: NSG rule allows any source, any port
predicates.description: An NSG inbound Allow rule uses a wildcard source ('*'/Any) and a wildcard destination port ('*'), providing no L4 filtering.
predicates.attack_vector: No L4 filtering -> full inbound exposure
predicates.recommendation: Replace with least-privilege rules; enforce deny-by-default.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups' | mv-expand rule = properties.securityRules | extend p = rule.properties | where p.access == 'Allow' and p.direction == 'Inbound' | where p.sourceAddressPrefix in ('*','Any') and p.destinationPortRange == '*' | project id, name = rule.name, nsgName = name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, direction = p.direction, access = p.access, sourceAddressPrefix = p.sourceAddressPrefix, destinationPortRange = p.destinationPortRange

predicates.title: Subnet without an associated NSG
predicates.description: A workload subnet has no associated Network Security Group, providing no L4 segmentation. Gateway/special subnets are excluded.
predicates.recommendation: Associate an NSG with deny-by-default rules to every workload subnet.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworks' | mv-expand subnet = properties.subnets | extend sp = subnet.properties | where isnull(sp.networkSecurityGroup) | project id = subnet.id, name = subnet.name, vnetName = name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, nsgId = tostring(sp.networkSecurityGroup.id)

predicates.title: Public web endpoint without WAF
predicates.description: An internet-facing Application Gateway / Front Door has no Web Application Firewall policy attached, or runs the WAF in detection-only mode.
predicates.attack_vector: Web application attacks reach origin unfiltered
predicates.recommendation: Attach a WAF in Prevention mode to public web endpoints; lock origin to the edge.

query.kql: Resources | where type in ('microsoft.network/applicationgateways','microsoft.network/frontdoors','microsoft.cdn/profiles') | extend publicExposed = true | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicExposed, wafEnabled = isnotnull(properties.firewallPolicy), wafMode = tostring(properties.policySettings.mode)
